items.html:
Qualification passed: 948 arguments over (x\in[0.5,10^4]), all degrees 0–64, 184,860 jet components. Worst error normalized by total jet magnitude was 2.73e-15, comfortably below 1e-13; no nonfinite results.

Artifacts:

  • Reproducible script
  • Raw summary and six reference rows

The reference uses independently differentiated finite polynomials at 90 digits, cross-checked against cylindrical Hankel functions and mp.diff. Metadata records mpmath version, seed, script hash, and limitations.

The failed Wronskian case comes from the AMOS regular derivative: independent comparison found J′ relative error 3.67e-13. Candidate outgoing flux error there is only 4.66e-16.

This qualifies complex jet accuracy empirically; it does not guarantee relative accuracy of a tiny real component when the imaginary component dominates. No source edits, builds, or timings performed.
